metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow popped 1 poor soul? Valorant’s aim took a day off
metadata.description:
Me: button mashing like it’s a panic ritual
Enemy: probably rethinking their life choices
How did I even get that kill? No clue, but I’m not complaining
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, you get this

Smash like if your panic aim ever surprises you!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
